purpose: Ninth and final independently reviewed batch. Each imported fact is supported by a continuous quotation from first-party airline material read on 2026-09-09. Dated first-party documents are identified explicitly; absence or ambiguity remains an intentional non-decision.

provenance_defaults.reviewer: Codex — direct reading of official airline material

facts.condition_scope: One dog or cat up to 9 kg in its container on domestic or regional flights, subject to advance handling, aircraft capacity, container, health and documentation conditions.
facts.finder_effect: Aerolíneas Argentinas cabin is conditional with a 9 kg combined dog-and-container ceiling on the stated network scope.
facts.quote: Se puede transportar solamente un perro o gato, de máx. 9 kilos en el contenedor correspondiente.

facts.condition_scope: A dog or cat exceeding the cabin weight or dimensions may travel in the aircraft hold, subject to availability, crate, route, health and documentation conditions.
facts.finder_effect: Aerolíneas Argentinas hold is a documented conditional route.

facts.condition_scope: Aerolíneas Cargo carries pets and other live animals subject to advance booking, station, route, customs, veterinary, crate, breed and temperature conditions.
facts.finder_effect: Aerolíneas Argentinas cargo is a documented conditional service.
facts.quote: Aerolineas Cargo ofrece transporte de mascotas y otros animales vivos a todos nuestros destinos.

facts.condition_scope: Dogs and cats may travel in cabin with an advance request; the animal and container together must not exceed 8 kg and aircraft, quota, container and documentation conditions apply.
facts.finder_effect: Air Astana cabin is conditional with an 8 kg combined animal-and-container ceiling.
facts.quote: Перевозка домашних животных (кошек или собак) в салоне самолета разрешена
facts.locator: Правила и нормы перевозки домашних животных в салоне самолета

facts.condition_scope: Dogs may travel as checked animals subject to advance request, route, aircraft, crate, cohabitation, age and documentation conditions; some destinations prohibit baggage transport entirely.
facts.finder_effect: Air Astana hold is a documented conditional route, with destination exclusions.
facts.quote: Правила перевозки животных в багажном отсеке
facts.locator: Правила перевозки животных в багажном отсеке

facts.condition_scope: Cargo under an air waybill is the documented route for animals to or from specified destinations where carriage as baggage is prohibited; cargo approval and route conditions apply.
facts.finder_effect: Air Astana cargo is documented for destination-restricted cases, not as an unconditional network-wide promise.
facts.quote: животные должны быть транспортированы исключительно по грузовой авианакладной
facts.locator: Существуют ли особые ограничения для других стран?

facts.condition_scope: Batik Air Indonesia states that pets are not permitted on its flights; assistance animals, if separately governed, are outside this ordinary-pet verdict.
facts.finder_effect: Batik Air Indonesia cabin is a documented refusal for ordinary pet dogs.
facts.quote: Batik Air Indonesia flights are not allowed to bring pets.

facts.condition_scope: The official prohibition covers ordinary pets on Batik Air Indonesia flights and provides no accompanied-hold exception.
facts.finder_effect: Batik Air Indonesia passenger hold is a documented refusal for ordinary pet dogs.

facts.condition_scope: Small domestic dogs and cats are identified as pets in cabin in a first-party ground-operations manual dated 24 January 2023; passenger-page conditions and current availability still govern.
facts.finder_effect: Croatia Airlines cabin is conditional, with the dated source flagged for early re-review.
facts.quote: Pets in cabin (PETC), such as: Small domestic animals (dogs and cats only).
facts.locator: Ground Operations Manual → 4.7.1 Stowing of Load in the Passenger Cabin → page 127

facts.condition_scope: A first-party service document describes a large-pet AVIH service for dogs and cats; it is dated 2019 and must be treated as an early re-review priority, not proof of present route availability.
facts.finder_effect: Croatia Airlines hold is conditional, with the dated source visibly flagged for early re-review.
facts.quote: Charge for PET in hold- LARGE (dogs and cats only, breed must be specified)
facts.locator: PET IN HOLD (AVIH-LARGE) → Service description and purpose

facts.condition_scope: Dogs and cats up to 8 kg including the carrier, subject to advance booking, seat, container, route, breed and documentation conditions.
facts.finder_effect: Edelweiss cabin is conditional with an 8 kg combined animal-and-carrier ceiling.
facts.quote: Only dogs and cats weighing up to a maximum of 8 kg including the pet carrier may travel in the cabin.

facts.condition_scope: Dogs and cats may travel in the aircraft hold, subject to advance booking, route, breed, crate, weight, aircraft and documentation conditions.
facts.finder_effect: Edelweiss hold is a documented conditional route.
facts.quote: travel in the luggage hold (which is lit and heated)
facts.locator: Animals FAQ → Are animals given something to drink during the flight?

facts.condition_scope: Unaccompanied pet freight is available through SWISS WorldCargo, subject to booking, route, station, crate and documentation approval.
facts.finder_effect: Edelweiss cargo is a documented conditional route through SWISS WorldCargo.
facts.quote: Your pet can also be transported unaccompanied as freight.
facts.locator: Animals FAQ → Can my pet be transported unaccompanied as freight?

facts.condition_scope: Dogs up to 10 kg including carrier may travel in cabin, subject to booking, route, breed, quota, container, health and documentation conditions.
facts.finder_effect: Neos cabin is conditional with a 10 kg combined animal-and-carrier ceiling.
facts.quote: you are allowed to transport them in the cabin

facts.condition_scope: Dogs over 10 kg including carrier may travel in the pressurized and ventilated hold, subject to route, breed, booking, crate, health and documentation restrictions.
facts.finder_effect: Neos hold is a documented conditional route above the 10 kg combined threshold.
facts.quote: transportation is authorised in the hold of the aircraft

facts.condition_scope: Dogs and cats up to 8 kg including the carrier, subject to advance confirmation, quota, passenger, aircraft, container, health and documentation restrictions.
facts.finder_effect: TAROM cabin is conditional with an 8 kg combined animal-and-carrier ceiling.
facts.quote: TAROM accepts only cats and dogs in the passenger cabin, weighing up to 8 kilos (including the weight of the standard transportation cage).

facts.condition_scope: Dogs and cats over 8 kg may travel in the hold, subject to advance confirmation, aircraft, breed, weight, crate, health, route and documentation restrictions.
facts.finder_effect: TAROM hold is a documented conditional route; A320 and brachycephalic restrictions apply.
facts.quote: Dogs and cats weighing more than 8kg can be transported safely in the hold

facts.condition_scope: Dogs over 40 kg excluding the cage may be accepted only as cargo; cargo booking, route, station, crate and documentation approval apply.
facts.finder_effect: TAROM cargo is a documented conditional route for dogs over the stated threshold.
facts.quote: May be accepted only as cargo.
facts.locator: In the hold → Conditions for Transport → For dogs over 40 kg

intentionally_unset.reason: The passenger help page rejects bringing pets on Batik Air Indonesia flights but does not establish whether a separately contracted ordinary-dog freight service exists. It must not be inferred from the passenger prohibition.

No current first-party pet policy with a continuous cabin quotation was located. The official 2020 conditions of carriage contain no animal-carriage section; another airline's similarly named conditions were rejected.
No current first-party Batik Air Malaysia text establishes accompanied pet transport in the hold. Silence in the official conditions is not a refusal.
No first-party text located establishes an ordinary-dog cargo service. Batik Air Indonesia and Malaysia Airlines sources are different carriers and were not imported.
The reviewed operational manuals discuss live-animal handling but do not establish a separately bookable ordinary-dog cargo offer for visitors.
The current accessible first-party material is a live-animal container checklist. It proves preparation requirements but does not assign ordinary pet dogs to the passenger cabin.
The current accessible first-party checklist does not state a weight or policy boundary for accompanied hold transport. Third-party summaries were rejected.
The accessible EL AL checklist and old Israel import form do not establish a current, generally bookable ordinary-dog cargo service.
The reviewed page reserves cargo wording for species other than dogs, cats and ferrets; it does not prove a general ordinary-dog cargo route.
